description: Division by 10: input A (0-255), output quotient in A, remainder in B

instruction_set.name: Z80 subset
instruction_set.description: ADD/ADC/SBC A,{A,B}, LD B,A, SLA/SRA/SRL A, RLA/RRA/RLCA/RRCA, RLC/RRC A, OR A, NEG, SCF, EX AF,AF'

search_parameters.output_mode: divmod (quotient in A, remainder in B)

interpretation: No Z80 instruction sequence of length ≤12 from the given instruction set computes integer division by 10 for all 8-bit inputs

search_space.pruning: Dead-state elimination, value tracking, early termination on first failing input
search_space.effective_explored: GPU explores ~10^12 states per B value with pruning

best_known_solution.method: Hacker's Delight reciprocal approximation with RRA+AND optimization
sequence: ADD A, B   ; A = n + n/2 (approx n*1.5)
AND 0x1F   ; mask to 5 bits (÷8 via shift)
LD B, A    ; B = quotient candidate
best_known_solution.note: Gap between lower bound (13) and best known (27) remains open
